chassis.name: Edge Striker
chassis.effect: Weapon Damage dealt using this item has the Slashing type unless the Action explicitly replaces it. Grip determines hand use and melee Range.
chassis.flavor: A simple damage-type foundation; the Grip supplies the tactical behavior.

chassis.name: Point Striker
chassis.effect: Weapon Damage dealt using this item has the Piercing type unless the Action explicitly replaces it. Grip determines hand use and melee Range.
chassis.flavor: A simple damage-type foundation; the Grip supplies the tactical behavior.

chassis.name: Impact Striker
chassis.effect: Weapon Damage dealt using this item has the Bludgeoning type unless the Action explicitly replaces it. Grip determines hand use and melee Range.
chassis.flavor: A simple damage-type foundation; the Grip supplies the tactical behavior.

chassis.name: Hooked Striker
chassis.effect: Choose Slashing or Piercing each time you declare a weapon attack using this item. Once per turn, when that attack successfully pushes or pulls a creature, increase that forced movement by 1 unit against one affected creature.
chassis.special: The extra movement requires an existing push or pull; it does not create one.

chassis.name: Concussive Striker
chassis.effect: This item deals Bludgeoning weapon Damage. Once per turn, after a weapon attack using it causes at least one Wound to a creature, reduce that creature’s Fortitude by 1 until the start of your next Turn.
chassis.special: A Wound absorbed by a Temporary Wound qualifies. This debuff occurs after the attack and cannot improve its own hit result.
chassis.flavor: A follow-through tool that opens a wounded target to the team.

chassis.name: Socketed Striker
chassis.effect: Choose Slashing, Piercing, or Bludgeoning when this Chassis is acquired. That is its weapon Damage type. It has two independent mounts and no additional inherent effect.
chassis.special: The chosen Damage type is part of this Chassis; changing it requires a different Chassis.
chassis.flavor: Augment capacity instead of a stronger ordinary attack.

chassis.name: Sidearm Launcher
chassis.effect: Attacks using this weapon ignore any penalty for making ranged attacks against adjacent targets. The Payload supplies weapon Damage type.
chassis.special: This removes an applicable penalty; it does not create a new universal adjacent-target penalty.

chassis.name: Scatter Launcher
chassis.effect: Once per turn, when declaring a single-target Action using this weapon, you may include all other valid targets within 1 unit of the initial target. Every added target must also be within this weapon’s Range and have a legal path for the effect. Resolve one roll.
chassis.special: The expansion is all eligible targets, not a chosen subset. The Action’s own ally/enemy restrictions still apply. Review interactions with control effects.

chassis.name: Rapid Launcher
chassis.effect: Once per turn, after rolling at least 4 dice for an attack with this weapon, reroll any number of those dice showing 3 or lower. Use the new results.
chassis.special: Does not create extra attacks or extra applications of on-hit effects.
chassis.flavor: Reliable volleys when committing a larger pool.

chassis.name: Precision Launcher
chassis.effect: Attacks using this weapon ignore cover. They still require a legal target and a path the effect can traverse; this property does not penetrate solid barriers or reveal undetected creatures.
chassis.special: The broad cover benefit is retained. The barrier/detection distinction follows S1 Valid Targets.

chassis.name: Suppressive Launcher
chassis.effect: Once per turn, when you declare an attack using this weapon, choose one target of that attack. Reduce its base Movement by 2 units, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next Turn. This does not require the attack to hit.
chassis.special: Declaration timing and base Movement are draft clarifications. The original effect did not require a successful hit.
chassis.flavor: Reliable movement pressure from a one-handed platform.

chassis.name: Socketed Launcher
chassis.effect: This Launcher has two independent mounts. Its Payload supplies weapon Damage type; it has no other inherent attack benefit.
chassis.flavor: A customizable platform that trades ordinary performance for mounts.

chassis.name: Reinforced Shell
chassis.effect: While worn, gain +1 Resilience and +1 Fortitude.

chassis.name: Balanced Shell
chassis.effect: While worn, gain +1 Resilience. If you are wearing this Shell when Combat begins, gain 1 Temporary Wound. Remove any unspent Temporary Wound granted this way when Combat ends.
chassis.special: A given Shell grants this only once per Combat. Wearing it later or refitting it does not grant another.
chassis.flavor: A small buffer against both ordinary harm and direct Wounds.

chassis.name: Fortress Shell
chassis.effect: While worn, gain +2 Resilience and reduce your base Movement by 4 units, to a minimum of 0.
chassis.special: Protection and its movement penalty remain on the same component.
chassis.flavor: High sustained protection with a substantial mobility cost.

chassis.name: Siege Shell
chassis.effect: At the end of your Turn, if you have not moved during that Turn, gain +3 Resilience until you move or the start of your next Turn, whichever happens first.
chassis.special: Movement includes forced movement and teleportation. Changing Resilience is not retroactive and never resets accumulated Damage; see D6.

chassis.name: Cognitive Shell
chassis.effect: While worn, gain +1 Resilience and +1 Composure. This Shell has two independent mounts.
chassis.flavor: Protection against mental attacks while retaining a general Damage buffer.

chassis.name: Resonant Shell
chassis.effect: While worn, gain +1 Resilience and +1 Harmony. This Shell has two independent mounts.
chassis.flavor: Protection against spiritual attacks while retaining a general Damage buffer.

chassis.name: Light Shield
chassis.effect: When you use a Reaction through this Shield that increases Fortitude, increase that Defense by an additional 1 for each creature protected by that Reaction.
chassis.special: “Through this Shield” follows the Source convention; applies to compatible learned Reactions as well as Equipment Guard.

chassis.name: Heavy Shield
chassis.effect: When you use a Reaction through this Shield that increases Fortitude, you may burn 1 additional Reaction die to increase that Defense by an additional 2 for the creatures protected by that Reaction.
chassis.special: The burned die is not rolled and generates no Surge.

chassis.name: Parrying Shield
chassis.effect: When you use a Reaction through this Shield that increases Fortitude against a melee attack, gain 1 free Surge for that Reaction.
chassis.special: The item occupies its printed hand allocation; its appearance does not make a hand free.
chassis.flavor: Reliable access to a defensive Surge in close combat.

chassis.name: Cognitive Shield
chassis.effect: When you use a Reaction through this Shield that increases Composure, increase that Defense by an additional 1 for each protected creature.

chassis.name: Resonant Shield
chassis.effect: When you use a Reaction through this Shield that increases Harmony, increase that Defense by an additional 1 for each protected creature.

chassis.name: Adaptive Shield
chassis.effect: During Recovery or Downtime, choose Fortitude, Composure, or Harmony. When you use a Reaction through this Shield that increases that Defense, you may burn 1 additional Reaction die to increase it by an additional 1. This Shield has two independent mounts.
chassis.special: The ordinary defensive benefit is deliberately less efficient than a dedicated Tier 1 Shield; versatility and mounts are the advantage.

chassis.name: Power Focus
chassis.effect: Once per turn, reduce one Stamina, Focus, or Mana cost of an Action or Reaction using this Implement as its Source by 1, to a minimum of 0.
chassis.special: Does not refund anything from a zero-cost Equipment Card. It cannot reduce dice, Uses, or other costs.

chassis.name: Channeling Focus
chassis.effect: Once per turn, one Action using this Implement as its Source gains 1 free Surge. This Focus requires a two-handed Interface.
chassis.special:
The extra Surge still needs a printed Surge option; unused Surges are lost.

Requires a two-handed Interface.

chassis.name: Stable Focus
chassis.effect: Once per turn, ignore the first penalty imposed by your Combat Style’s Specialty on an Action or Reaction using this Implement as its Source. This Focus requires a two-handed Interface.
chassis.special:
Draft interpretation: ignore one discrete negative modifier, not a cost, stack change, maintenance requirement, or an entire Specialty Condition. Exact Specialty interactions require testing.

Requires a two-handed Interface.

chassis.name: Shaping Focus
chassis.effect: Once per turn, when using an area attack through this Implement, exclude one otherwise valid target from that attack.
chassis.special: Excludes the target from the attack, not from a persistent area that continues to exist afterward.

chassis.name: Reservoir Focus
chassis.effect: If you are holding this Implement with both hands when Combat begins and at the start of your first Turn, add 2 dice to your Action Pool at that first Turn’s start. This Focus requires a two-handed Interface.
chassis.special:
The start-of-Combat holding requirement prevents handoff/refitting refreshes. Added dice do not increase maximum rolled dice.

Requires a two-handed Interface.

chassis.name: Conduit Focus
chassis.effect: This Focus has two independent mounts and no additional inherent numerical benefit. Its Interface and the Actions it supplies determine how it operates.
chassis.flavor: An Augment platform for any Implement user.

fittings.name: Light Grip
fittings.effect: After resolving an attack using this weapon as its Source, you may move 1 unit. This is granted Movement, not an increase to your remaining normal Movement.
fittings.special: No once-per-turn limit has been added. Ordinary Movement restrictions and Reaction triggers still apply.

fittings.name: Balanced Grip
fittings.effect: Once per turn, after rolling an attack using this weapon as its Source and before choosing the Success Die, reroll one of those dice. Use the new result.
fittings.special: Uses the catalog’s one-reroll-per-die convention; see D5.

fittings.name: Heavy Grip
fittings.effect: A successful attack using this weapon that rolls at least 4 dice inflicts 1 additional Wound on each successfully hit target after its other effects resolve. Use the weapon’s Damage domain for this Wound. Temporary Wounds absorb it normally.
fittings.special: Preserves an additional Wound, not additional Damage. Burned dice do not count. No once-per-turn cap. Applying this to every hit target is an explicit draft interpretation; high-priority playtest.
fittings.flavor: A large commitment converts directly into additional injury.

fittings.name: Extended Grip
fittings.effect: An enemy beginning a voluntary movement within this weapon’s melee Range must spend 1 additional unit of that movement the first time it increases its distance from you. Apply this once to each distinct movement, not to every step.
fittings.special: Draft clarification of “when moving away”: once per distinct movement. It does not affect forced movement or teleportation; multiple copies do not tax the same movement repeatedly.

fittings.name: Driving Grip
fittings.effect: Once per turn, after a successful attack using this weapon, push or pull one successfully hit target 1 unit.
fittings.special: The movement need not deal Damage; the attack must hit.

fittings.name: Guarded Grip
fittings.effect: Once per turn, after successfully hitting a creature with this weapon, gain +1 Fortitude against the next attack that creature makes against you before the start of your next Turn. The benefit then ends.

fittings.name: Sweeping Grip
fittings.effect: Once per turn, when declaring a single-target damaging Action with this weapon, you may include one additional legal target. Both targets must be within this weapon’s Range and within 1 unit of each other. Roll at least 3 dice and resolve one roll against both targets.
fittings.special: Use the same Effect and Surges for both targets. The Action and its Rider each resolve once; see D4.
fittings.flavor: A controlled two-target alternative to Heavy Grip.

fittings.name: Anchored Grip
fittings.effect: Once per turn, after rolling at least 3 dice for an attack using this weapon, reroll up to two of those dice if you have not moved since the start of your most recent Turn. Use the new results.
fittings.special: Any movement, forced movement, or teleportation breaks the condition until your next Turn.
fittings.flavor: A stable two-handed attack with a positioning condition.

fittings.name: Piercing Payload
fittings.effect: Weapon Damage dealt by this item has the Piercing type unless the Action explicitly replaces it. Ordinary ammunition is abstracted.

fittings.name: Impact Payload
fittings.effect: Weapon Damage dealt by this item has the Bludgeoning type unless the Action explicitly replaces it. Ordinary ammunition is abstracted.

fittings.name: Cutting Payload
fittings.effect: Weapon Damage dealt by this item has the Slashing type unless the Action explicitly replaces it. Ordinary ammunition is abstracted.

fittings.name: Driving Payload
fittings.effect: This item deals Bludgeoning weapon Damage. Once per turn, after an attack with it successfully hits, push one hit target 1 unit.
fittings.flavor: Ranged forced movement without a new learned card.

fittings.name: Marking Payload
fittings.effect: This item deals Piercing weapon Damage. Once per turn, after an attack with it hits, mark one hit creature until the start of your next Turn. While within your line of effect, that creature cannot become undetected by you through concealment alone.
fittings.special: Does not negate solid barriers, grant sight through walls, remove cover, identify a creature, or reveal it to allies.
fittings.flavor: Keeping track of a target through concealment.

fittings.name: Breaching Payload
fittings.effect: This item deals Piercing weapon Damage. Once per turn, when an attack with it rolls at least 4 dice and deals Damage, give 1 point of that Damage Breach against one hit target. This changes that point; it does not add Damage.
fittings.special: Breach still meets Temporary Wounds. Only one target and one Damage point benefit.

fittings.name: Scout Rigging
fittings.effect: While this armor is worn, increase your base Movement by 2 units.

fittings.name: Skirmisher Rigging
fittings.effect: After you voluntarily move at least 4 units during your Turn, gain +1 Fortitude until the start of your next Turn. Count normal and granted Movement; do not count teleportation.
fittings.special: Voluntary movement and teleportation exclusions are explicit draft timing clarifications.

fittings.name: Braced Rigging
fittings.effect: Reduce each push or pull that would move you by 1 unit, to a minimum of 0. This does not affect teleportation.

fittings.name: Articulated Rigging
fittings.effect: Reduce the base Movement penalty imposed by this Shell by 2 units, to a minimum penalty of 0. Once per turn, ignore the additional Movement cost of Difficult Terrain for up to 2 units you move.
fittings.special: Does not reduce penalties from other items or effects.

fittings.name: Reactive Rigging
fittings.effect:
This Rigging's effect: While this armor is worn, you may use the Defensive Step Equipment Reaction.

Defensive Step (EC04)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Vigor; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: Self / Self

Trigger: Another character declares an attack against your Fortitude; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Increase your Fortitude by 1 against the triggering attack. Roll only to generate Surges.

Surge 1: After the triggering attack resolves, move 1 unit. Once per use.

Design note: This Reaction does not provide a second Reaction window for its user against the same Action.

fittings.name: Formation Rigging
fittings.effect: Once per turn, when a Reaction you use increases one of your Defenses against an attack, choose one adjacent ally also targeted by that attack. That ally gains +1 to the same Defense against that attack. This property may contribute while another item is the Source.
fittings.special: No extra Reaction is created. You must actually increase your own Defense.
fittings.flavor: Sharing a small amount of protection against multi-target attacks.

fittings.name: Ready Shield Grip
fittings.effect:
This Grip's effect: Gain the Equipment Guard Reaction, targeting yourself.

Equipment Guard (EC01)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Vigor / Resolve / Anima; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: Self; expanded by Grip / One protected creature; Braced Grip may protect two

Trigger: Another character declares an attack targeting a creature this Shield’s Grip can protect; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Choose a Defense contested by the triggering attack: Fortitude uses Vigor, Composure uses Resolve, or Harmony uses Anima. Increase that Defense by 1 for the protected creature against the triggering attack. Apply this Shield’s compatible properties. Roll only to generate Surges; the base increase is automatic.

Surge 1: Increase the same Defense by an additional 1 against the triggering attack. Once per use.

Design note: Uses one Reaction against that Action. The dice cap uses the selected Attribute under D1.

fittings.name: Intercept Shield Grip
fittings.effect:
This Grip's effect: Gain Equipment Guard. It may protect you or one adjacent ally. When you protect an ally, reduce your own chosen Defense by 1 until the start of your next Turn.

Equipment Guard (EC01)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Vigor / Resolve / Anima; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: Self; expanded by Grip / One protected creature; Braced Grip may protect two

Trigger: Another character declares an attack targeting a creature this Shield’s Grip can protect; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Choose a Defense contested by the triggering attack: Fortitude uses Vigor, Composure uses Resolve, or Harmony uses Anima. Increase that Defense by 1 for the protected creature against the triggering attack. Apply this Shield’s compatible properties. Roll only to generate Surges; the base increase is automatic.

Surge 1: Increase the same Defense by an additional 1 against the triggering attack. Once per use.

Design note: Uses one Reaction against that Action. The dice cap uses the selected Attribute under D1.
fittings.special: Repeated uses refresh, but do not stack, the personal penalty for the same Defense.
fittings.flavor: Trading personal safety to defend an ally.

fittings.name: Braced Shield Grip
fittings.effect:
This Grip's effect: Gain Equipment Guard. It may protect you and one adjacent ally against the same attack, using the same chosen Defense and Surges. If you have not moved since the start of your most recent Turn, the Reaction grants an additional +1 to that Defense.

Equipment Guard (EC01)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Vigor / Resolve / Anima; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: Self; expanded by Grip / One protected creature; Braced Grip may protect two

Trigger: Another character declares an attack targeting a creature this Shield’s Grip can protect; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Choose a Defense contested by the triggering attack: Fortitude uses Vigor, Composure uses Resolve, or Harmony uses Anima. Increase that Defense by 1 for the protected creature against the triggering attack. Apply this Shield’s compatible properties. Roll only to generate Surges; the base increase is automatic.

Surge 1: Increase the same Defense by an additional 1 against the triggering attack. Once per use.

Design note: Uses one Reaction against that Action. The dice cap uses the selected Attribute under D1.
fittings.special: Both protected creatures must be targets of the triggering attack. Any movement breaks the bracing condition.

fittings.name: Mobile Shield Grip
fittings.effect:
This Grip's effect: Gain Equipment Guard, targeting yourself. After the attack that triggered it resolves, you may move 1 unit.

Equipment Guard (EC01)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Vigor / Resolve / Anima; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: Self; expanded by Grip / One protected creature; Braced Grip may protect two

Trigger: Another character declares an attack targeting a creature this Shield’s Grip can protect; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Choose a Defense contested by the triggering attack: Fortitude uses Vigor, Composure uses Resolve, or Harmony uses Anima. Increase that Defense by 1 for the protected creature against the triggering attack. Apply this Shield’s compatible properties. Roll only to generate Surges; the base increase is automatic.

Surge 1: Increase the same Defense by an additional 1 against the triggering attack. Once per use.

Design note: Uses one Reaction against that Action. The dice cap uses the selected Attribute under D1.

fittings.name: Reprisal Shield Grip
fittings.effect:
This Grip's effect: Gain Equipment Guard, targeting yourself. After the triggering attack resolves, if it failed to hit you and the attacker is adjacent, push the attacker 1 unit.

Equipment Guard (EC01)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Vigor / Resolve / Anima; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: Self; expanded by Grip / One protected creature; Braced Grip may protect two

Trigger: Another character declares an attack targeting a creature this Shield’s Grip can protect; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Choose a Defense contested by the triggering attack: Fortitude uses Vigor, Composure uses Resolve, or Harmony uses Anima. Increase that Defense by 1 for the protected creature against the triggering attack. Apply this Shield’s compatible properties. Roll only to generate Surges; the base increase is automatic.

Surge 1: Increase the same Defense by an additional 1 against the triggering attack. Once per use.

Design note: Uses one Reaction against that Action. The dice cap uses the selected Attribute under D1.
fittings.flavor: Turning a failed close attack into separation.

fittings.name: Projection Interface
fittings.effect:
This Interface's effect: Gain Equipment Projection. Choose its Physical, Mental, or Spiritual profile during Recovery or Downtime; record the choice on the item.

Equipment Projection (EC02)

ACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Profile vs Profile

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Single creature

Effect: Use the profile recorded on the Interface. Physical: Grace vs Fortitude; deal 1 Force Damage on a hit. Mental: Acuity vs Composure; deal 1 Psychic Damage on a hit. Spiritual: Adaptability vs Harmony; deal 1 Radiant Damage on a hit. This is an ordinary Source attack, not a Function Augment.

Surge 1: After resolving the attack, move 1 unit. Once per use; does not require a hit.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Damage to the hit target. Once per use.

Design note: Channeling Interface increases Range to 8. Profiles are a catalog convention, not a universal relation between Damage type and Defense.
fittings.flavor: A basic ranged capability across any of the three domains.

fittings.name: Guiding Interface
fittings.effect:
This Interface's effect: Gain the Guide Equipment Action. The recipient still chooses its own Action and targets.

Guide (EC03)

ACTION • Burn 2 • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 6 units / One willing ally other than yourself

Effect: Choose an ally you can detect that can perceive your guidance. Its next Action before the start of your next Turn gains 1 free Surge. Multiple Guides on one ally do not stack. This grants no additional Action and never determines the ally’s choice.

Design note: No roll, no success gate, no Surge options. No social compulsion or automatic persuasion.
fittings.flavor: Simple tactical support without controlling another character.

fittings.name: Channeling Interface
fittings.effect:
This Interface's effect: Gain Equipment Projection and choose its profile during Recovery or Downtime. Increase the numeric Range of your Actions using this Implement as Source by 2 units. This does not alter Self, Touch, adjacency, Weapon Range, or area dimensions.

Equipment Projection (EC02)

ACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Profile vs Profile

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Single creature

Effect: Use the profile recorded on the Interface. Physical: Grace vs Fortitude; deal 1 Force Damage on a hit. Mental: Acuity vs Composure; deal 1 Psychic Damage on a hit. Spiritual: Adaptability vs Harmony; deal 1 Radiant Damage on a hit. This is an ordinary Source attack, not a Function Augment.

Surge 1: After resolving the attack, move 1 unit. Once per use; does not require a hit.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Damage to the hit target. Once per use.

Design note: Channeling Interface increases Range to 8. Profiles are a catalog convention, not a universal relation between Damage type and Defense.
fittings.special: Equipment Projection has Range 8 with this Interface. This does not change Reaction Range.

fittings.name: Anchored Interface
fittings.effect:
This Interface's effect: Gain Equipment Projection and choose its profile during Recovery or Downtime. Once per turn, after rolling at least 3 dice for an Action using this Implement, reroll up to two dice showing 3 or lower if you have not moved since the start of your most recent Turn.

Equipment Projection (EC02)

ACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Profile vs Profile

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Single creature

Effect: Use the profile recorded on the Interface. Physical: Grace vs Fortitude; deal 1 Force Damage on a hit. Mental: Acuity vs Composure; deal 1 Psychic Damage on a hit. Spiritual: Adaptability vs Harmony; deal 1 Radiant Damage on a hit. This is an ordinary Source attack, not a Function Augment.

Surge 1: After resolving the attack, move 1 unit. Once per use; does not require a hit.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Damage to the hit target. Once per use.

Design note: Channeling Interface increases Range to 8. Profiles are a catalog convention, not a universal relation between Damage type and Defense.
fittings.special: Any movement breaks the condition. Uses the one-reroll-per-die convention.

fittings.name: Protective Interface
fittings.effect:
This Interface's effect: Gain the Equipment Screen Reaction. It protects Composure or Harmony, not Fortitude.

Equipment Screen (EC05)

REACTION • Roll 2+ • USES — • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Resolve / Anima; automatic effect

Range / Targeting: 3 units / Self or one willing ally

Trigger: Another character declares an attack contesting Composure or Harmony against the target; use before the attack is rolled.

Effect: Choose the contested Defense: Composure uses Resolve, Harmony uses Anima. Increase that Defense by 1 for the target against the triggering attack. Roll only to generate Surges.

Surge 1: After the triggering attack resolves, the protected creature may move 1 unit. Once per use.

Design note: Can target yourself. Does not increase Fortitude or grant an extra Reaction.

augments.name: Returning
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

At the start of your Turn, this item may return to one free hand if it is within 6 units and a clear path connects it to you. It cannot return while another creature holds it, through a solid barrier, or while fixed in place. Returning is not an attack and moves no other object.
augments.flavor: Recovering thrown, dropped, or disarmed equipment without another Action.
augments.special: Does not itself make an item throwable or grant a ranged attack. Two-handed use still requires the other hand.

augments.name: Prismatic
augments.compatibility: Melee Weapon / Ranged Weapon / Magical Implement
augments.effect:
Requirement: The host must be usable as Source for a damaging Action.

Before rolling an ordinary damaging Action using the host as Source, you may replace all Damage it deals with Fire or Cold, chosen for that Action. The targeted Defense and all printed Conditions remain unchanged.
augments.flavor: Changing Damage type rather than simply increasing output.
augments.special: This sample contains the fixed pair Fire/Cold. Other fixed pairs can be separate discoveries; the user does not choose freely from every Damage type.

augments.name: Echoing
augments.compatibility: Melee Weapon / Ranged Weapon / Magical Implement
augments.effect:
Requirement: The host must be usable as Source for a damaging Action.

Once per turn, after an ordinary Source Action deals Damage to a creature, leave a visible echo in one space that creature occupies. Before the start of your next Turn, the first different creature entering that space takes 1 Damage of the type just dealt, then the echo ends. An unused echo ends at the start of your next Turn.
augments.flavor: A hit leaves a small, temporary positioning hazard.
augments.special: Affects allies as well as enemies. Echo Damage is not an attack, repeats no Rider, and triggers no Source on-hit property or further echo.

augments.name: Refracting
augments.effect:
Requirement: The host must supply an ordinary ranged Source Action with a numeric Range.

Once per turn, an ordinary ranged Source Action may follow a path with one bend in an empty space you can detect. You must detect the target; both path segments must be unobstructed and their combined length cannot exceed the Action’s Range. Measure directional cover from the final segment.
augments.flavor: Attacking around an intervening obstacle without seeing through it.
augments.special: Does not increase Range, bend a melee attack, alter an area’s shape, or bypass a sealed wall.

augments.name: Anchoring
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

While this item is active, another creature cannot teleport you or exchange your position with another space or creature unless you are willing. Ordinary forced movement still affects you.
augments.flavor: A categorical answer to hostile spatial displacement.

augments.name: Sheltering
augments.effect:
Requirement: The host must have an ordinary property or Equipment Card that grants a Temporary Wound.

When an ordinary property or Equipment Card of this item would grant you a Temporary Wound, you may instead grant it to one adjacent willing ally. Preserve its original duration and restrictions. You do not gain it, and no additional Temporary Wound is created.
augments.flavor: Redirecting a limited protective buffer.
augments.special: Balanced Shell supplies a working starting combination. Function Augments are not modified; the normal five-Temporary-Wound cap applies.

augments.name: Sympathetic
augments.effect:
Requirement: The host must have a temporary Defense increase that can apply to its user.

When this item’s ordinary property or Equipment Card would temporarily increase one of your Defenses, you may give that increase to one adjacent willing ally instead. Preserve its duration and scope. A bonus restricted to one attack can be transferred only to an ally targeted by that attack.
augments.flavor: Sharing protection without duplicating it.
augments.special: Does not transfer permanent Shell bonuses, remove a drawback, or duplicate a bonus. Function Augments are not modified.

augments.name: Phase Step
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

During the first voluntary movement you take on each turn, you may pass through one creature-occupied space. You must finish in a legal unoccupied space and have enough granted or normal Movement to do so. This does not bypass walls, terrain costs, hazards, or Reaction triggers.
augments.flavor: Moving through a blocked battle line without gaining extra distance.

augments.name: Suspended
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

While this item is active, you may end Movement unsupported in midair if you are adjacent to a solid vertical surface and no more than 3 units above a supporting floor or ground. You remain there without falling. This grants no Movement, flight, or ability to pass through a surface.
augments.flavor: Holding an unusual position beside a wall.
augments.special: If the item becomes inactive or the conditions stop being met, ordinary falling rules apply. Multiple copies do not increase the permitted height.

augments.name: Momentum Sink
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Once per turn, when a push or pull would move you, you may redirect the full movement along a different straight path on a surface you can traverse. The entire distance must be legal; otherwise use the original movement. This does not reduce distance or change teleportation.
augments.flavor: Redirecting force instead of resisting it.
augments.special: Apply reductions such as Braced Rigging first. The remaining full distance must fit the new path; a nearby wall cannot turn this into automatic immunity.

augments.name: Selective
augments.compatibility: Melee Weapon / Ranged Weapon / Magical Implement
augments.effect:
Requirement: The host must be usable as Source for a damaging area Action.

When an ordinary area Action using this item as Source deals Damage, you may exempt any number of willing allies in its area from that Damage. Its other effects, including forced movement and Conditions, still apply normally.
augments.flavor: Reducing collateral Damage without making the whole effect harmless.
augments.special: Unlike Shaping Focus, this does not exclude a creature from every effect. It does not modify a Function Augment.

augments.name: Afterguard
augments.effect:
Requirement: The host must grant an ordinary Equipment Reaction that increases the user’s Defense.

When an ordinary Equipment Reaction through this item increases your Defense against one attack, retain 1 point of that increase after the attack resolves until the start of your next Turn. The retained point is part of the original increase, not an additional bonus.
augments.flavor: Extending a little protection beyond its original timing window.
augments.special: Retained bonuses from Afterguard do not stack for the same Defense, even from multiple items. Refreshing a duration creates no new Reaction.

augments.name: Repulse
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Repulse (EC06)

ACTION • Roll 2+ • USES 3 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Might vs Fortitude

Range / Targeting: Self / Cone 3; every creature in the cone

Effect: Each successfully affected creature takes 1 Force Damage and is pushed 2 units directly away from you.

Surge 1: Push one successfully affected creature 1 additional unit. Once per use.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Force Damage to each successfully affected creature. Once per use.
augments.flavor: A short cone of force and displacement.

augments.name: Rift Step
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Rift Step (EC07)

ACTION • Burn 2 • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Self; optionally one adjacent willing ally

Effect: Teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 6 units. You may take one adjacent willing ally, placing it in a legal unoccupied space adjacent to your destination. Both destinations must be within 6 units of your starting space. This teleport does not require a traversable path between start and destination.

Design note: No roll or Surges. Does not grant sight through barriers; neither traveler can take additional creatures.
augments.flavor: A limited escape or coordinated crossing.

augments.name: Aegis
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Aegis (EC08)

REACTION • Burn 2 • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 3 units / Self or one willing ally

Trigger: The target would take Damage from another character’s Action or Reaction; use after that Damage is determined but before it is accumulated.

Effect: Reduce that Damage by 2, to a minimum of 0. When an event contains several Damage types or Breach, choose which points are removed. This does not prevent separately inflicted direct Wounds.

Design note: Prevention, not healing. Still consumes the user’s one Reaction against that Action.
augments.flavor: Preventing a dangerous Damage event across all domains.

augments.name: Null Pulse
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Null Pulse (EC09)

ACTION • Roll 2+ • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Resolve vs Composure

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Sphere 1; every creature in the area

Effect: Each successfully affected creature cannot use Reactions until the start of your next Turn. This does not cancel a Reaction already declared or stop Actions on its own Turn.

Surge 1: Deal 1 Psychic Damage to each successfully affected creature. Once per use.

Surge 2: Reduce each successfully affected creature’s Composure by 1 for the same duration. Once per use.

Design note: No persuasion, loyalty change, interrogation effect, or out-of-Combat behavioral compulsion.
augments.flavor: Opening a brief interval in which enemies cannot react.

augments.name: Sever
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Sever (EC10)

ACTION • Roll 3+ • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Anima vs Harmony

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Single creature

Effect: On a hit, deal 2 Necrotic Damage. You may also end one temporary beneficial Combat effect currently affecting the target. You must be able to identify the effect; this does not reveal hidden effects. It cannot remove an inherent feature, an equipped item’s continuous property, a Specialty Condition, or a Wound Condition.

Surge 1: Deal +1 Necrotic Damage. Once per use.

Surge 2: Give 1 point of this Damage Breach. Once per use; no additional Damage.

Design note: Ends one existing application, not the source ability. A continuing external aura may reapply according to its own rules.
augments.flavor: Harming a target while removing one temporary combat advantage.

augments.name: Overdrive
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Overdrive (EC11)

ACTION • Burn 2 • USES 1 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 3 units / Self or one willing ally

Effect: At the start of the target’s next Turn, add 3 dice to its Action Pool and increase its base Movement by 3 units for that Turn. Added dice do not increase maximum rolled dice and expire with that Action Pool. The target can benefit from Overdrive only once per Combat, even from different copies.

Design note: Does not grant an extra Turn or let the target act immediately. No extra Reaction dice.
augments.flavor: A deliberately timed burst of next-turn capacity.

augments.name: Bulwark Field
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Bulwark Field (EC12)

ACTION • Burn 3 • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Sphere 1 centered on a point you can see

Effect: Create an immobile field until the start of your next Turn. Every creature inside it gains +2 Resilience while inside. This includes enemies. Leaving ends the bonus; reentering restores the bonus but does not reset accumulated Damage or restore Wounds. Overlapping Bulwark Fields do not stack.

Design note: Changing Resilience causes no retroactive Wounds or healing. The field is not a solid barrier and does not block targeting.
augments.flavor: A fixed, temporary protected position.

augments.name: Gravitic Snare
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Gravitic Snare (EC13)

ACTION • Roll 3+ • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Intellect vs Fortitude

Range / Targeting: 6 units / Sphere 1; every creature in the area

Effect: Each successfully affected creature takes 1 Force Damage. Until the start of your next Turn, it can voluntarily move no more than 2 units in total after this effect is applied, counting normal and granted Movement. This does not limit forced movement or teleportation.

Surge 1: Pull each successfully affected creature 1 unit toward the center of the area, stopping before an illegal space. Once per use.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Force Damage to each successfully affected creature. Once per use.

Design note: This is an explicit movement restriction, not an undefined Slowed or Restrained Condition.
augments.flavor: A strong, temporary restriction on ordinary movement.

augments.name: Displacement
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Displacement (EC14)

REACTION • Burn 2 • USES 1 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: 3 units / Self or one willing ally

Trigger: Another character declares an Action targeting the protected creature; use before that Action is rolled or resolved.

Effect: The protected creature cannot be affected by the triggering Action. This explicitly prevents that Action’s effects against that creature; its other targets and independent effects resolve normally. After the Action finishes, the protected creature may teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 2 units of itself.

Design note: Cancels effects against one creature, not the entire Action. Does not protect against separate nested Actions or Reactions, existing hazards, or later attacks.
augments.flavor: An exceptional one-use answer to a declared attack.

augments.name: Suppress Injury
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Suppress Injury (EC15)

ACTION • Burn 2 • USES 2 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: Touch; self or adjacent / One living willing creature

Effect: Choose up to two Wound Conditions on the target. Suppress their penalties until the end of the current Encounter, or for 1 minute if used outside an Encounter. Their Core Wounds remain marked and still determine Wound State. This does not restore Temporary Wounds, repair bodily loss, stabilize a Critical Wound, or stop any rule for dying.

Design note: Never suppresses the existence of a Wound or makes the target count as less injured. Not healing.
augments.flavor: Temporarily functioning through injuries without removing them.

augments.name: Restoration
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Restoration (EC16)

ACTION • Burn 3 • USES 1 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Automatic; burn the printed dice

Range / Targeting: Touch; self or adjacent / One living willing creature

Effect: Restore the target’s most severe currently marked Core Wound and remove its corresponding Wound Condition. Follow the normal reverse-order recovery rule. A creature can benefit from Restoration only once per Adventure, even from different copies. This cannot revive the dead or recreate a missing limb or organ.

Design note: Exceptional healing, not a consumable-kit baseline. If a Wound represents an injury this Function cannot repair, it cannot restore that Wound.
augments.flavor: A deliberately exceptional example of genuine healing.
augments.special: Major treasure; not assumed starting equipment. This is the only Function here that restores a Core Wound.

augments.name: Convergence
augments.effect:
Requirement: An active compatible modular item with one empty mount.

Convergence (EC17)

ACTION • Roll 4+ • USES 1 • RESOURCE 0

Resolution: Equipment + Presence vs Harmony

Range / Targeting: 8 units / Sphere 2; every creature in the area

Effect: Each successfully affected creature takes 3 Radiant Damage.

Surge 1: Pull one successfully affected creature 1 unit toward the center of the area. Once per use.

Surge 2: Deal +1 Radiant Damage to each successfully affected creature. Once per use.

Design note: Hits allies too. Ordinary Support Augments do not reshape or select targets for this Function under D2.
augments.flavor: A major area payoff with one Adventure-limited Use.
augments.special: Major treasure. Four rolled dice may be inaccessible to a low-Attribute user under D1.
